patterns: APPSC asks direct single facts: SCCL ownership 51% Telangana : 49% GoI (asked twice, 2019), 'which is NOT a coalfield' (Mosabani = copper).
Recurring classics: anthracite highest carbon; Gondwana rocks hold >90-98% of coal; Indian coal = high ash, low sulphur; coking coal imported (Australia).
Coalfield-state matching (Jharia, Raniganj, Bokaro, Talcher, Singareni) is the core AP-relevant shape.
App adds many 2024-26 current-affairs items (gasification scheme outlays, auction rounds, UCG clauses) in multi-statement form, far more detailed than PYQs show.
